confidence_notes: Medium for beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors; lower for the midrange meal, wine, cocktail and all accommodation anchors. Beer and coffee are based on a Tokyo price table (November 2025), Fukuoka crowd-sourced data and a 2026 cost guide, adjusted down for a smaller regional city. No citywide Tottori price survey was found, so meal anchors rest on Tottori menu listings and national Japanese ranges. Wine and cocktail anchors use 2026 posted Tokyo hotel and bar menus adjusted downward, with cocktail set at about twice the beer price. Yen amounts are converted at an assumed rate of about 150 yen per USD, not a verified July 2026 rate, so every food and drink anchor moves in proportion to the actual yen rate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of regional Japanese hotel rates, not from inspected listings. The FX observation (0.6720 on 2026-11-18) comes from search-result snippets that cite the RBA exchange rates page; I did not open that page directly, and no 19 November reading was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Tottori is treated as a small regional Japanese prefectural capital priced below Tokyo, using Tokyo and Fukuoka reference prices with an assumed regional discount, plus national Japanese menu ranges.
